svg.text: PG-1 wiring 1/10: Power: 9V jack -> power switch -> carrier board -> Seed3
+ (red) goes into BOTH commons, A and B. Lugs 2 3 4 and 6 7 8 are all ON: link them with bare offcuts (the short silver links, bent round
the OUTSIDE so they never touch lug 1 or 5) and run ONE red wire from them to 'dc +'. Lugs 1 and 5 = OFF: leave them empty.
back of the switch: lug numbers 1-8, A and B are moulded on it
Seed3 socket: the jumper-end block in the right wall, from INSIDE (USB-C end on your left)
Steps (the number is on the wire)
9V jack: the SLEEVE lug, on the side: + -> power
switch: common A (the inner lug by the moulded 'A')
power switch: common A (the inner lug by the moulded
'A') -> power switch: common B (the inner lug by the
power switch: lug 2 (pole A, position 2) -> carrier
ON lugs -> dc + (join A2-A4 and B2-B4 with bare offcuts
power switch: lug 2 (pole A, position 2) -> power
power switch: lug 3 (pole A, position 3) -> power
power switch: lug 4 (pole A, position 4) -> power
power switch: lug 6 (pole B, position 2) -> power
power switch: lug 7 (pole B, position 3) -> power
9V jack: the CENTRE-PIN lug, the middle one: - (centre
9 V - straight to the board (female end on the header)
jumper: Seed3 ground (the ground chain is spliced onto
